audit: Choice postprocessing recomputed from preserved model answers. Source hashes verified; prepared-image hashes recorded after inference using identical RGB/1280 preprocessing. No inference rerun.
timing_definition: timing_ms.median is the upper middle sorted observation for an even sample count, not the average of the two middle observations.
